prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on your goals (style, length, budget, language needs). Below are top options by use case plus quick selection tips so you can pick the best one for you.

Top picks by use case
- Synthesia / HeyGen / Elai.io — Best for ads with realistic AI presenters/avatars and multi‑language voiceovers. Great when you want a talking host without hiring actors. Good brand control; faster than on‑camera shoots.
- Canva / InVideo / Biteable / Promo.com — Best for fast, template‑driven social ads (stories, reels, feed). Very easy, lots of templates, text animations, aspect ratios, and stock footage.
- Vidyo.ai / Repurpose.ai — Best for repurposing long videos into many short ad clips automatically (high ROI for creators/brands with existing long form content).
- Descript — Best for editing ads with precise voiceover control (Overdub), script‑driven cuts, and simple sequence editing. Excellent if you want audio-first editing and quick iteration.
- Vyond / Animaker — Best for animated explainer ads or playful product animations where characters and scenes are needed.
- Pictory / Lumen5 — Best for turning blog posts or scripts into short video ads using stock footage and auto captions.
- Runway / Kaiber — Best for creative, generative video effects and more cinematic/experimental ads (higher learning curve).
- Promo.com / Shakr — Best for scale and ad networks — built specifically for marketing teams creating lots of ad variants.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Output style: live presenter, animated, text+stock, or generative/experimental?
- Platforms & aspect ratios: do you need vertical Reels/Stories or square/landscape?
- Languages & voices: need multi‑language TTS or lip-synced avatars?
- Speed vs control: templates are fast; advanced tools give more customization.
- Budget: free tiers exist but exports/branding often require paid plans.
- Rights & licensing: confirm stock footage and voice rights for ads.
- Integrations: ad platforms, CMS, team collaboration, analytics.

Recommended quick workflow
1. Pick 2–3 candidates from above.
2. Use free trials to create a 15–30s ad and test on the target platform.
3. Measure performance (CTR, CPM, CPC) and iterate.

If you tell me: your budget, ad length, platform (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok), whether you want a real presenter or animation, and if you already have footage, I’ll recommend the single best option and a short workflow tailored to your needs.
